description.value: Elphinstone Cycles is a full-service community bike shop on BC's Sunshine Coast with two locations in Gibsons and Sechelt. The shop carries major brands including Santa Cruz, Specialized, Giant, Norco, and Cannondale, and employs factory-trained mechanics who service all makes and models. Touring cyclists will find professional repair services and quality bike rentals — including e-bikes — making it a practical stop for exploring the Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms an active full-service bike shop on BC's Sunshine Coast with two locations (Gibsons and Sechelt). Factory-trained mechanics servicing all makes and models, plus walk-in drop-off language, support the urgent mechanicals criterion; e-bike rentals and sales confirm e-bike service capacity; no pump, washrooms, DIY stand, or other unmentioned amenities are referenced. The OSM address omits suite #104 compared to the website, and OSM carries no phone while the website lists (778) 280-8088 for the Gibsons location — both updated to website values.
